# ADR-0003: Xcode project generated by XcodeGen

Date: 2026-08-30 · Status: accepted · Milestone: 3

## Context

The PRD calls for an Xcode project (section 11). Hand-maintained
`project.pbxproj` files are merge-hostile and error-prone to edit outside
the Xcode GUI.

## Decision

The project is described in `apple/Culler/project.yml` and generated with
XcodeGen (`brew install xcodegen`; `cd apple/Culler && xcodegen generate`).
The generated `Culler.xcodeproj` is committed, mirroring the PRD's rule for
UniFFI bindings: plain Xcode works without any extra tooling installed.

## Consequences

- Target/settings changes go in `project.yml`, then regenerate. Don't edit
  the pbxproj by hand; ad-hoc Xcode-side tweaks will be overwritten.
- `CullerCore.xcframework` is a gitignored build product: run
  `scripts/build-xcframework.sh` once after cloning (needs Rust), after
  which Xcode builds standalone. The generated Swift bindings ARE committed.
- Code signing is ad-hoc (`CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: "-"`), no sandbox/hardened
  runtime: personal app, not App Store (PRD non-goals).
